"This chart illustrates the **Primary Balance** for Argentina, measured in **Billions of AR$ (Argentine Pesos)**. The data represents a "cumulative floor since the start of the year," meaning the values reset to zero at the beginning of each calendar year.

### Chart Components
*   **Title:** Primary Balance
*   **Units:** Billions of AR$ (cumulative floor since start of year)
*   **Legend:** 
    *   **Light Blue Line:** Actual Primary Balance
    *   **Dark Blue Line:** Primary Balance (PB) Target (7th review)
*   **Y-Axis:** Values ranging from -6000 to 6000 in increments of 2000.
*   **X-Axis:** Timeframe from January 2023 to July 2024.

### Data Summary
The table below provides approximate values extracted from the chart's visual trends:

| Date | Actual Primary Balance (Billions AR$) | PB Target (7th Review) (Billions AR$) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **2023 Data** | | |
| Jan-23 | ~ -200 | ~ -400 |
| Mar-23 | ~ -800 | ~ -400 |
| May-23 | ~ -1200 | ~ -1200 |
| Jul-23 | ~ -2200 | ~ -2200 |
| Sep-23 | ~ -2800 | ~ -2200 |
| Nov-23 | ~ -3200 | ~ -3100 |
| Dec-23 | ~ -5800 | ~ -3100 |
| **2024 Data** | | |
| Jan-24 | ~ +2000 | ~ +1000 |
| Feb-24 | ~ +3200 | ~ +1000 |
| Mar-24 | ~ +3800 | ~ +1000 |
| Apr-24 | ~ +4100 | ~ +1900 |
| May-24 to Jul-24 | No data | ~ +1900 (Flat) |

### Key Observations
*   **2023 Performance:** For most of 2023, the actual balance was negative and generally tracked close to the set targets until the end of the year, when the actual deficit significantly exceeded the target, dropping to approximately -5800 billion AR$.
*   **2024 Performance:** Following the start-of-year reset, the primary balance shifted to a surplus. In early 2024, the "Actual" performance substantially outperformed the "Target," reaching over +4000 billion AR$ by April, while the target remained lower at approximately +1900 billion AR$."
